title: Recipient asks for delivery to a neighbour and the neighbour's details are missing
next_action: Ask the recipient for the neighbour's full name and door number, and nothing else.
boundary: Ask only for the neighbour's name and door number; no entry codes or phone numbers. A recorded instruction is not a handover.
outcome: Dispatch records the neighbour instruction on the route card; handover to the neighbour remains pending.

title: Recipient asks for an earlier delivery and dispatch has two earlier slots
next_action: Ask the recipient to choose one of the two dispatcher-confirmed earlier slots.
boundary: Do not book until the recipient chooses. A booking is not a delivery.
outcome: Dispatch books the earlier slot the recipient chose; delivery remains pending.

title: Business recipient's receiving hours are missing from the order
source_role: Pell Demmary, Thistlewick Joinery receiving coordinator
action_to: Pell Demmary, Thistlewick Joinery receiving coordinator
next_action: Ask the business receiving coordinator for the site's receiving hours on the delivery date only.
boundary: Ask for receiving hours only; no other site details. Recorded hours are not a delivery appointment.
outcome: Routing records the receiving hours on the booking; delivery remains pending.

title: Driver is at the door with a broken intercom and no answer
next_action: Call the recipient on the verified order callback route and ask them to come to the door within the driver's wait limit.
boundary: Call only the verified order callback route; do not ask for keys or codes. The recipient's answer on the call is not a handover; only the driver's scan proves it.
outcome: The recipient came to the door and the driver's handover scan records the delivery.

title: Recipient wants the parcel left in a safe place and must specify it under the service terms
next_action: Ask the recipient to name one exact safe-place location that meets the stated terms.
boundary: A safe-place instruction needs the exact location and the recipient's acceptance of the stated terms. A recorded instruction is not a delivery.
outcome: Dispatch records the safe-place instruction with the accepted terms; delivery remains pending.

title: Order contact number is outdated so the callback request cannot be saved
next_action: Ask the recipient to send the current contact number in the verified order thread.
boundary: A new number must come through the verified order thread; a number from an unverified message is not used. A recorded callback is not a call.
outcome: Dispatch updates the contact number from the verified thread and saves the callback; arrival remains pending.

title: Two-person delivery to an upper floor needs lift status and stair count
next_action: Ask the recipient whether a working lift takes the carton and how many stairs lead to the door.
boundary: Customer answers support planning; the crew decides on arrival. There is no advice to carry items, and an active booking is not a delivery.
outcome: The delivery team accepts the access answers and keeps the booking active; delivery remains pending.

title: After a failed attempt the recipient must choose redelivery or a pickup point
stage: returned to depot after a failed attempt
next_action: Ask the recipient to choose between the two dispatcher-confirmed options: redelivery or pickup-point collection.
boundary: Offer only the two options dispatch confirmed. A choice is not a delivery, and a transfer booking is not a collection.
outcome: Dispatch books the pickup-point transfer the recipient chose; collection remains pending.

title: Recipient asks for a fragile handling flag before loading
next_action: Ask dispatch to apply the fragile handling flag before loading.
boundary: A handling flag is a route instruction, not a guarantee against damage. Packaging, liability and the delivery slot are unchanged.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the flag on the route card; delivery remains pending.

title: Business sender wants a second carton added to a booked collection before cut-off
source_role: Rook Ellisand, Quernhollow Bindery shipping coordinator
next_action: Ask the collections desk to add the second carton to the booked collection before the cut-off.
boundary: A carton added to the booking is not collected. The stated 16:00 UTC cut-off on the day before collection applies to any further change.
outcome: The collections desk updates the booking to two cartons; collection remains pending.

title: Recipient wants a signature on handover instead of the default safe-place service
next_action: Ask dispatch to replace the safe-place handover with signature on handover and keep the booked slot.
boundary: The signature flag changes the handover rule, not the delivery date. A recorded flag is not a completed delivery.
outcome: Dispatch records the signature flag on the booking; delivery remains pending.

title: Recipient wants a pickup-point redirect reversed to home delivery before transfer
next_action: Ask routing to cancel the redirect before transfer and rebook home delivery in the accepted slot.
boundary: Reversal is possible only before transfer, and the routing record confirms that no transfer had occurred. Rebooked is not delivered.
outcome: Routing confirms the redirect is cancelled and home delivery is rebooked; delivery remains pending.

title: Recipient wants SMS route notifications enabled on the verified number
next_action: Ask notification services to enable SMS route notifications on the verified order number only.
boundary: Notifications go to the verified number only. A notification is not an arrival-time guarantee.
outcome: Notification services enables SMS on the verified number; delivery remains pending.

title: Recipient wants to collect from the depot counter today by appointment
next_action: Ask depot operations to book the requested same-day counter appointment under the identification rule.
boundary: An appointment is not a collection. The stated photo identification requirement applies at the counter.
outcome: Depot operations books the counter appointment; collection remains pending.

title: Business consignee changes the receiving dock for tomorrow's pallet before loading
source_role: Caddis Kethwin, Brindlecove Supply receiving coordinator
next_action: Ask the freight planner to amend the booking to the new dock on the same site and keep the window.
boundary: A dock change is a booking amendment; unloading conditions are assessed on arrival. The amended booking is not a completed delivery.
outcome: The freight planner amends the booking to the new dock; delivery remains pending.

title: Recipient asks for the collection reference to be re-sent to the verified email
next_action: Ask notification services to re-send the collection reference to the verified order email only.
boundary: Re-sending goes only to the verified email on the order. A reference is not a collection.
outcome: Notification services re-sends the reference to the verified email; collection remains pending.

title: Recipient asks whether Saturday delivery is possible and what it costs
next_action: Ask scheduling for available Saturday slots and the total charge without changing the booking.
boundary: Quote before changing; the desk does not set prices, and acceptance must come in the verified thread. A Saturday booking is not a completed delivery.
outcome: The recipient accepts the quoted Saturday slot and charge in the verified thread and Scheduling books it; delivery remains pending.

title: Business sender asks the price and earliest date for a next-day pallet collection
source_role: Selka Hovrin, Quarrystep Ceramics shipping coordinator
next_action: Ask the freight planner for the earliest next-day collection and the total surcharge without changing the booking.
boundary: No booking change until the sender accepts the quoted charge in the verified thread. A booked collection is not a collected pallet.
outcome: The coordinator accepts the quoted surcharge in the verified thread and the freight planner books the collection; collection remains pending.

title: Recipient asks whether the parcel can be redirected to another city and at what cost
next_action: Ask routing for redirect eligibility, the delivery slot and the total charge without applying the redirect.
boundary: Eligibility and charge come only from routing; no redirect until the recipient accepts. An applied redirect is not a delivery at the new address.
outcome: The recipient accepts the quoted redirect in the verified thread and Routing applies it; delivery at the new address remains pending.

title: Recipient asks what hold options beyond three days exist and whether storage is charged
next_action: Ask depot operations for extended hold options and storage charges without changing the hold.
boundary: Only the depot quotes storage terms; no hold applied until the recipient accepts. An extended hold is not a release or a collection.
outcome: The recipient accepts the quoted extended hold in the verified thread and the depot applies it; release remains pending.

title: Reschedule request timed out in the dispatch system and the recipient asks whether it is booked
next_action: Ask dispatch what the saved booking shows before any resubmission of the reschedule.
boundary: Check the saved booking before resubmitting; a timeout is not proof that the change failed. No duplicate booking is created, and a booking record is not a delivery.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the reschedule was applied once and no second change was made; delivery remains pending.

title: Hold request email bounced and the depot status is unclear
next_action: Ask the depot to report what its stock record shows before any hold is resubmitted.
boundary: Verify the stock record first and resubmit only if the hold is confirmed absent. A bounced email is not proof that nothing was received, and a hold is not a release.
outcome: The depot finds no hold and applies one hold once after a single resubmission; release to the recipient remains pending.

title: Pickup-point portal showed an error after the extension was submitted
next_action: Ask the pickup-point operator what its record shows before any second extension is submitted.
boundary: Ask the operator what its record shows and do not submit a second extension blindly. A portal error is not proof the extension failed, and an extended deadline is not a collection.
outcome: The operator confirms the extension was recorded once with a new deadline; collection remains pending.

title: Routing never acknowledged a redirect and the depot scan is ambiguous
next_action: Ask routing to confirm the saved destination and current parcel state before any new redirect.
boundary: Determine the actual parcel state before any new instruction; no second redirect is sent. In transit is not arrived at the pickup point.
outcome: Routing confirms the original redirect was saved once and the parcel is in transit to the pickup point; arrival remains pending.

title: Recipient reports that the delivery van damaged a garden fence
action_to: Safety incident queue, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action: Register the damage report with the carrier’s incident queue, stating the facts, sources and the exact question.
boundary: Register the report with facts and the exact question only. Registration is not a liability or compensation decision, and the desk promises no repair payment.
outcome: The incident is registered with a reference and next update time; the liability decision remains pending.

title: Recipient insists on delivery today and no policy option exists
action_to: Operations supervisor queue, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action: Register the same-day request with the operations supervisor queue, stating the facts and the exact decision needed.
boundary: Promise the customer nothing. Queue acceptance is not a decision, and the existing booking is not changed.
outcome: The queue accepts the request with a decision deadline; the outcome and delivery remain pending.

title: Two people claim the same parcel and the account name does not match the order
next_action: Open a verification case with the carrier’s account verification team, stating the facts, sources and the exact question.
boundary: No handover to either claimant and no account details shared with them. Opening a verification case is not a finding of who is entitled.
outcome: The parcel is held and a verification case is open with a next update time; handover remains pending.

title: Depot flags a missing hazardous-goods label on a parcel containing a battery
next_action: Register the labelling fault with the carrier’s compliance queue, stating the depot’s facts and the exact decision needed.
boundary: The desk cannot lift a compliance hold or authorise relabelling. Registration is not clearance.
outcome: The compliance review is registered with a reference and next update time; the hold remains and delivery is pending.

title: Recipient has not chosen a slot for two days and the offer expires today
next_action: Send one reminder to the recipient stating the offer deadline and the consequence of no choice.
boundary: One reminder on the verified channel, and no booking is made without the recipient’s choice. A booking confirmation is not a completed delivery.
outcome: The recipient chooses before expiry and dispatch confirms the booking with the deadline recorded; delivery remains pending.

title: Pickup-point operator has not answered an extension request and the deadline is tomorrow
next_action: Chase the pickup-point operator once, stating the hold expiry time and the consequence.
boundary: One chase only; the desk cannot extend on the operator’s behalf. An extension is not a collection.
outcome: The operator approves the extension before expiry; collection remains pending.

title: Nominated neighbour has not accepted the handover nomination required before route release
next_action: Remind the recipient that the nominated neighbour must accept before the route-release cutoff, and state what happens if no acceptance is recorded.
boundary: The route is not released without the neighbour's own acceptance, and the desk cannot accept on his behalf. Route release is not a completed delivery.
outcome: Recipient services records the neighbour's acceptance before the cutoff and releases the parcel to the route; delivery remains pending.

title: Recipient asks for the driver's personal phone number
next_action: Decline to share the driver's personal number under the carrier's policy and offer the callback instruction instead.
boundary: A driver's personal number is never shared, and the desk passes on no driver contact details. A recorded callback instruction is not a confirmed arrival time.
outcome: The recipient accepts the callback instruction and Dispatch records it on the booking; arrival remains pending.

title: Recipient asks to change the address to another city after route release
next_action: Decline the address change under the carrier's post-release policy and offer the merchant-initiated return as the permitted alternative.
boundary: The address is not changed after route release, and the return is initiated by the merchant, not the desk. A return request is not a completed return or a new shipment.
outcome: The recipient chooses the return option and the merchant's return request is recorded; the return and any new shipment remain with the merchant.

title: Recipient asks to leave the parcel with building security that has no registered receiving arrangement
next_action: Decline handover to the unregistered third party under the carrier's policy and offer the pickup-point or household-nomination options.
boundary: Building security is not a registered receiving arrangement, so the parcel is not left there. A redirect record is not a collection.
outcome: The recipient chooses the pickup-point redirect and Recipient services records it; arrival at the counter and collection remain pending.

title: Business sender asks the desk to waive a correctly applied redelivery fee
source_role: Dace Rovane, Larkfold Ceramics shipping coordinator
action_to: Dace Rovane, Larkfold Ceramics shipping coordinator
next_action: Decline the fee waiver because the desk does not set or waive charges, and point to the billing dispute route if the sender wants one.
boundary: The desk does not set or waive prices. A registered billing dispute is not a waiver, and a booked redelivery is not a completed delivery.
outcome: The sender opens a billing dispute with Business billing; the desk makes no waiver, and the redelivery stays booked unchanged.

title: Recipient cancels the reschedule request before dispatch has booked anything
next_action: Record the withdrawal with the team that owns the booking, forbid any new change, and ask what was already executed.
boundary: The original slot stands only because Dispatch confirmed that no change was applied. A withdrawn request is not a booking change, and a booking is not a completed delivery.
outcome: Dispatch records the withdrawal and confirms the original booking is unchanged; delivery remains pending.

title: Merchant cancels the order while a pickup-point redirect is in progress
source_role: Quen Tarvik, Brackfen Goods shipping coordinator
next_action: Record the shipper's stop with the team that owns the redirect, forbid new movement, and ask what was already executed.
boundary: Stopping the redirect halts new movement only, and a held parcel is not a return to sender. The return instruction is a separate merchant decision.
outcome: Routing halts the redirect at the depot and holds the parcel; the merchant's return instruction remains pending.

title: Recipient withdraws a hold request after returning earlier than planned
next_action: Record the hold withdrawal with the team that owns the hold, forbid any other change, and ask what was already executed.
boundary: Removing the hold returns the parcel to normal routing; it does not set a delivery date. Back in routing is not out for delivery.
outcome: Depot operations removes the hold and returns the parcel to normal routing; the delivery date and the delivery remain pending.

title: Recipient refuses a parcel at the door saying it was not ordered
source_role: Route driver Bram Tollek, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action: Record the refusal and its stated reason with the team that owns the route, ask for the driver's record, and leave return authorisation to the merchant.
boundary: Return authorisation is a separate merchant decision that the desk does not start. A refusal is not a refund, and a parcel back at the depot is not a completed return.
outcome: Dispatch records the refusal and the parcel returns to the depot; the merchant's return instruction remains pending.

title: Business receiving desk refuses a pallet with a crushed corner
source_role: Halden Ressik, Quarrymint Foods receiving coordinator
stage: driver on site with the pallet
next_action: Record the consignee's refusal with the freight team, ask for the driver's damage record, and leave the claim and the return to their owners.
boundary: The desk records the refusal and asks for the damage record only. A refusal is not a damage claim, and the claim and the return are separate processes the desk does not open.
outcome: The refusal and the driver's damage record are logged and the pallet is back at the depot; the desk opened no claim, and the return awaits the shipper.

title: Recipient wants to refuse a parcel the day after it was handed over
next_action: Register the request with the returns desk as a return, with the handover record attached, and leave authorisation to the merchant.
boundary: After handover this is a return request, not a refusal. Merchant authorisation is required before any collection, and a registered request is not an approved return or a refund.
outcome: Returns desk registers the return request with the handover record attached; merchant authorisation is still pending.

title: Recipient refuses one carton of a three-carton order and accepts the other two
next_action: Ask dispatch to have the driver record the refusal against the refused carton's own ID and keep the order open.
boundary: Each carton is recorded by its own ID, and two delivered cartons are not a completed order. A doorstep refusal is not a return to the merchant, which needs separate authorisation.
outcome: Two cartons are handed over and the refusal of the third is recorded against its own ID; the order remains open.

title: Recipient sent the same reschedule request by portal and email and dispatch opened two tickets
next_action: Ask dispatch to link the second ticket to the first and apply a single booking change.
boundary: The second ticket is a duplicate, not a second request, so only one booking change applies. A booking change is not a completed delivery.
outcome: Dispatch closes the duplicate ticket as linked and confirms one booking change; delivery remains pending.

title: Pickup-point operator sees two extension requests for the same parcel
next_action: Ask the counter supervisor to confirm the first extension request and withdraw the second as a linked duplicate.
boundary: Two requests are not two extensions; a single permitted extension applies. An extended deadline is not a collection.
outcome: The supervisor records one extension and withdraws the duplicate; collection remains pending.

title: Recipient's partner who is not on the order asks to change the delivery address
next_action: Ask the verified recipient to confirm in the order thread whether the delivery address should change.
boundary: A partner's request is not the recipient's authorisation, so nothing is changed or disclosed on it. Only the verified recipient can change the address.
outcome: The verified recipient confirms the new address in the order thread and the address desk updates it; delivery remains pending.

title: Business staff member accepts GBP 45.00 extra cost when the recorded authority is GBP 30.00
source_role: Rook Valdane, Fernhollow Joinery site coordinator
action_to: Ismay Zorvane, Fernhollow Joinery account signatory
next_action: Ask the registered account signatory to approve or decline the charge through the verified business portal.
boundary: An acceptance above the recorded authority is not an approval, so the planner must not allocate beyond GBP 30.00 without the registered signatory. An allocation is not completed unloading.
outcome: The signatory approves the charge within a newly recorded limit and the planner allocates the service; unloading remains pending.

title: Merchant support agent asks the desk to release a parcel to a new recipient name
source_role: Saffi Wexley, Brackenloom Textiles support agent
action_to: Tobin Yarlow, Brackenloom Textiles shipping coordinator
next_action: Ask the merchant's registered shipping coordinator to submit a verified order amendment if the recipient change is correct.
boundary: A support agent's request is not an order amendment, and the desk cannot rename the recipient. An updated record is not a delivery.
outcome: The coordinator's amendment arrives through the verified channel and the depot updates the shipment; delivery remains pending.

title: Driver record says handed to the recipient but the recipient says a stranger took it in the lobby
next_action: Request a delivery investigation that keeps both statements and asks for the handover evidence.
boundary: A recorded handover is not proof of who took the parcel, and the recipient's account is not a finding of loss or fault. Both statements stay on file until the evidence is reviewed.
outcome: The carrier registers the investigation with an evidence request and a next update time; the finding is pending.

title: Depot weight differs from the merchant manifest for the same parcel
next_action: Ask depot operations to record a verification scan and keep both weights unchanged.
boundary: A weight difference is not evidence of tampering or a wrong parcel. Neither weight is overwritten, and release to routing is not a delivery.
outcome: The verification scan explains the difference as packaging and the parcel is released to routing; delivery remains pending.

title: Merchant email and carrier booking show different delivery dates
next_action: Ask dispatch to confirm the booked date and slot from its booking record before the customer is told either date.
boundary: A merchant email is not a carrier booking, so neither date is told to the customer as fact until Dispatch confirms it. A confirmed booking is not a delivery.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the booked date from its record and the recipient is informed; delivery remains pending.
